description: Check if your text is a pangram containing every letter A–Z, with missing letters listed.

faqs.a: A pangram uses every letter of the alphabet at least once, like 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'.
Any letters not found in your text are listed so you can add them.
Yes — only the letters A-Z are checked, ignoring case, spaces and punctuation.

howto: See the verdict and any missing letters.
title: Pangram Checker
